rca of the issue: Root cause: In /app/frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.jsx, StatModal (line ~297) is defined as a separate component outside the Dashboard component. The Balance Tally inner rows call `setModalKind(...)` which is only in scope inside Dashboard, not inside StatModal. The claimed fix (pass `switchKind` prop) was never committed — grep for `switchKind` in /app/frontend/src returns nothing. Reproduction: open `/`, click dashboard-balance-card, click tally-income-upi → red 'setModalKind is not defined' overlay. Mitigation: (1) Add `switchKind` to StatModal props signature. (2) In Dashboard's StatModal invocation add `switchKind={setModalKind}`. (3) Replace all `setModalKind(...)` calls inside the balance-tally case with `switchKind(...)`.
